bullets.title: UBS raises S&P 500 targets; Citi says buy pre-midterm dips
bullets.body: UBS raised its S&P 500 targets to 8,100 (Dec 2026) and 8,400 (June 2027), citing tech/semis strength and EPS expectations of $350 in 2026 and $400 in 2027. Citi maintains overweight equities and recommends adding exposure on any pullbacks ahead of midterm elections, citing supportive earnings revisions and improving liquidity with 'limited warning signs.'

bullets.title: S&P 500 earnings momentum at historic highs: 69% beat revenue, 64% beat guidance
bullets.body: Of 465 S&P 500 companies reporting Q2, 69% beat revenue expectations and 64% of firms issuing Q3 guidance exceeded consensus — described as the highest share on record for guidance beats. Context for continued bull case in large-cap tech.

bullets.title: BofA warns: 30-year yields above 5% risk asset sell-off; AI shorts expected to build
bullets.body: BofA's Michael Hartnett warns that failure of the U.S. Treasury bond plan — with 30-year yields staying above 5% — could trigger selling in risk assets, dollar weakness, and increased short positioning against AI names specifically.

bullets.title: 30-year Treasury yields near decade highs at 5.23% after hitting 5.311% Monday
bullets.body: Long-term bond yields remain elevated despite Treasury intervention efforts; the 30-year eased to ~5.23% Friday after hitting a nearly 20-year closing high of 5.311% on Monday. Bond market volatility also moved higher, with policy environment described as unpredictable.

bullets.title: US Dollar hits new cycle lows post-government intervention
bullets.body: Keith McCullough flags the US Dollar breaking to new cycle lows following what he characterizes as US government intervention/manipulation, reinforcing the weak-dollar macro backdrop. He remains long Euros and Yen.

bullets.title: SPX correcting on decelerating volume: risk range shows only -0.4% downside vs +2.5% upside
bullets.body: SPX is correcting from ATHs for the 3rd day in 4 on decelerating volume, which Hedgeye reads as marginally bullish. Their Risk Range signal shows only -0.4% daily downside with +2.5% upside to new ATHs at 7835. Separately, XLF implied volatility spiked +77% above 30-day realized vol on 'consensus panic-selling.'

bullets.title: OPEX day: bulk of SPX positioning expired at open; residual in weeklies and single-stocks
bullets.body: Options expiration reminder: most SPX positioning ceases trading at today's open, with residual exposure concentrated in weekly and single-stock options — suggesting potential for reduced intraday volatility post-open.

bullets.title: Conference Board LEI turns positive for first time in 4+ years; Philly Fed capex forecasts at multi-decade highs
bullets.body: The 6-month annual change in the Conference Board Leading Economic Index turned positive for the first time in more than four years, with 9 of 10 components advancing. Philadelphia Fed's 6-month forecasts for general activity and capex are at multi-decade highs, and employment/workweek components hit cycle highs in August.

bullets.title: Jackson Hole: Fed Chair Warsh expected to offer modest reassurance on policy
bullets.body: TD Securities expects Fed Chair Kevin Warsh to provide modest reassurance for investors at the Jackson Hole symposium, with markets watching for clearer signals on his policy approach amid an elevated yield environment.

bullets.title: Tesla recalls ~2.74M-2.98M vehicles in China over door-release safety issue
bullets.body: China's market regulator ordered Tesla to recall approximately 1.96M–2.98M vehicles (Model Y, and in some reports Model 3/Y) made in China, over emergency door-release safety concerns. The fix involves warning labels and a software update that lowers windows — described as Tesla's largest-ever recall in China.

bullets.title: AI sector at 'Aversion' phase; MU made higher-high but must hold above invalidation level
bullets.body: One fintwit macro-cycle trader characterizes AI broadly as being at the 'Aversion' stage of the market cycle, with crypto approaching 'Anxiety.' On MU specifically, the same account notes the stock has bounced to form a higher-high but must prove itself above the invalidation level, with stop-loss under recent discouragement lows.

bullets.title: AI capex projected as largest GDP boost in history; Bloomberg
bullets.body: Bloomberg cited AI infrastructure investment as expected to deliver the largest capex-driven GDP contribution in economic history — broadly supportive of hyperscaler and semiconductor capex narratives.

bullets.title: Alibaba flagged as having structural edge in monetizing AI agents
bullets.body: Commentary circulating that Alibaba has competitive first-mover or structural advantages in AI agent monetization, positioning it ahead of competitors in that emerging market segment.

bullets.title: Samsung launches $80B shareholder return; SK Hynix Japan facility decision still pending
bullets.body: Samsung announced an $80 billion shareholder return program, framed as a competitive response to SK Hynix's aggressive buyback. Separately, SK Hynix confirmed it has not yet made a decision on its Japan facility.

bullets.title: AI data center LPDDR5X demand creating supply constraints affecting consumer electronics pricing
bullets.body: AI data centers are consuming LPDDR5X RAM supply, with downstream consequence flagged as potentially making PlayStation 6 handheld hardware less affordable — a signal of tightening memory supply across end markets.

bullets.title: Bitcoin surges to $78-79K, up $15K since Monday; BTC RSI at 84
bullets.body: Bitcoin broke through $79,000, up $15K since Monday and +21% week-to-date. The Market Ear notes BTC RSI at 84 with shorts 'obliterated.' Hedgeye maintains Bitcoin as 'Bullish TRADE and TREND.' MicroStrategy's BTC position is reportedly back in the green.

bullets.title: Ackman Q2 portfolio: UBER 12.7%, MSFT 11.9%, AMZN 10.5% as top three holdings
bullets.body: Bill Ackman's Q2 13F visualized: UBER represents 12.7% ($2.5B), MSFT 11.9% ($2.3B), and AMZN 10.5% ($2.0B) of his portfolio — flagging continued conviction in mega-cap tech and consumer internet.

bullets.title: Analyst optimism at 'Gekko-era' levels — dot-com bubble comparison raised
bullets.body: Edwards/The Market Ear flag analyst optimism at levels only previously seen before the dot-com bubble and in post-recession recoveries, raising a contrarian sentiment warning even as earnings beats remain historically strong.

bullets.title: Trump's 50% tariffs set to kick in after midnight; Iran sanctions may target Chinese banks
bullets.body: Trump's 50% tariffs were set to take effect just after midnight, with immediate market implications pending. Separately, Washington is preparing tougher Iran economic isolation measures that could target major Chinese banks buying ~90% of Iran's oil exports, risking trade escalation with Beijing.

bullets.title: New York overtakes San Francisco as top US tech talent market for first time in 13 years
bullets.body: A new CBRE report found New York's office market now hosts more tech workers than San Francisco — the first time in 13 years of CBRE analysis — with AI growth cited as the primary driver of the geographic shift.
